purpose: Research only (direction A): can a monthly trend filter or volatility target cut the drawdown of the 45/40/15 core ETF plan at an acceptable return cost? No real money until the gate and a 26-week forward observation both pass.

data.tw_sleeve: 006208.TW adjusted close (TWD). 0050.TW excluded: spurious >15% one-day move on 2014-01-02 in Yahoo data.
data.us_sleeve: SPY adjusted close (USD) x TWD=X close (one-day reversing spikes > 20% replaced by the previous value), minus annual drag 1.03% calibrated as SPY-in-TWD minus 00646.TW over 2015-12-02..2026-11-20 (data QA only, no strategy returns)

sample.first_signal: first month-end with 252 trading days of 006208 history (2013-07-31)

execution: signals at month-end close; trades at the next trading day's close; weights drift between trades

S0_static.rule: every 6 months (June and December month-ends) trade back to target only the sleeves more than 5 percentage points away

A1_trend.rule: at each month-end, a risk sleeve gets its target weight if its total-return price is at or above its 200-trading-day simple moving average, otherwise 0 (moved to cash); trade only when a signal flips or a sleeve is more than 5 points off its rule weight

A2_voltarget.rule: at each month-end, total risk weight R = min(0.85, 0.10 / sigma), sigma = annualised std of daily returns of the 45:40 risk mix over the last 63 trading days; sleeves R*45/85 and R*40/85, cash 1-R; trade only when a sleeve is more than 5 points off

all_required_vs_S0: full-sample MDD at least 5 percentage points shallower
Calmar (CAGR / |MDD|) higher in the full sample and in each half
full-sample CAGR no more than 1.5 percentage points per year below S0
longest time under water (weeks) no longer than S0
gate.if_both_pass: A1 and A2 both pass: the one with the higher full-sample Calmar goes forward (rule fixed now)
gate.if_pass: 26-week forward observation with the frozen rule (no real money); only then may the user switch the core plan
gate.if_none_pass: keep S0 (current core plan); direction A closed

report: longest and current time under water (weeks)
calendar-year returns and count of full years below 6%
monthly excess vs S0: mean and Newey-West t (descriptive)
trial_logging: each arm (S0, A1, A2, B) appended to results/trial_log.csv as stage ETF_RISK_V1 when the one-shot run happens
